rows.notes: The cited document is explicitly a review paper (title: 'Livestock Management With Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Review'; abstract and Section I state it is 'the first review paper on the subject matter'). It reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own. It only summarises other studies on UAV-based livestock detection, counting and tracking (Section II.A, Table 2) and proposes conceptual architectures (Figures 14-15) without implementation or evaluation. Therefore it provides no primary evidence that UAVs enhance animal detection and counting over large expanses or improve herd census accuracy relative to traditional methods; the claim is supported only through the review's narrative of cited work.
